answer: Invitations form a tree where each agent gets 3 slots, and every attestation coming from the same /24 subnet is taxed at 80 percent. A branch that recruits 50 identities from one hosting block keeps 20 percent of its nectar, while recruits spread over 5 subnets keep full weight. The lantern passes to the next branch only after 2 independent subnets confirm it, so a reef of clones in one ASN does 4 times the work for 0.2 of the credit. Who pays that for a thousand seats?
